description.zh:
播流所属应用名称。

> 如果需要全部App都触发回源，则取值**ali_all_app**。
description.en:
The name of the application.

> To trigger origin fetch for all applications, set this parameter to **ali\_all\_app**.

description.zh:
回源拉流App。

> 如果使用播放URL中的App，则此参数为空。
description.en:
The source application name.

> Leave this parameter empty to use the application name from the playback URL of the source stream.

description.zh: 直播流所在的源站。多个源站使用英文分号（;）分隔。
description.en: The origin server that hosts the live stream. To specify multiple origin servers, separate them with semicolons (;).

The protocol to use for pulling the stream from the source. Valid values:

- **rtmp**

- **httpflv**

- **hls**

description.zh:
转码播放触发拉流。默认为**no**。可选值：

- **yes**

- **no**
description.en:
Specifies whether to trigger stream pulling when a request for a transcoded stream is made. Default value: **no**. Valid values:

- **yes**

- **no**

descriptions.zh:
本接口的拉流方式属于触发拉流，即当需要拉取的源站开始播放直播流时，自动触发阿里云视频直播服务进行拉流直播。

> 本接口暂时不支持IPv6协议。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This API configures triggered stream pulling. When a live stream starts on the origin server, ApsaraVideo Live automatically pulls the stream for live playback.

> This API does not support the IPv6 protocol.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-live-lazy-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name ali_all_app --pull-domain-name guide.aliyundoc.com --pull-app-name livePullApp0000 --transcode-lazy no --pull-protocol rtmp --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live SetLiveLazyPullStreamInfoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --TranscodeLazy no --DomainName 'example.com' --PullProtocol rtmp --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PullDomainName 'guide.aliyundoc.com' --PullAppName livePullApp0000 --AppName ali_all_app
